title: Procter & Gamble sales top $23.3 billion in strong Q1 2027
summary: The Q1 2027 4% sales increase for Procter & Gamble (P&G), the owner of Olay and Herbal Essences, was driven by its beauty division, which benefited particularly from hair care demand

title: Selfridges unveils Christmas campaign in London, Manchester, Birmingham and digital stores
summary: Luxury British department store chain Selfridges has released its Christmas campaign, taking consumers around the world through festive cityscapes and in-store experiences

title: Armani Beauty ambassador Jonathan Bailey fronts new ‘The Power of Will’ interview series
summary: British actor Jonathan Bailey, who is ambassador for Armani Beauty’s I Will men’s fragrance, stars in a new video series for the scent, alongside fellow ambassadors, musician J Balvin, Formula 1 driver Carlos Sainz and entrepreneur Simon Squibb

title: La Roche-Posay to Neutrogena: New BEMT sunscreens hitting shelves in the US
summary: Bemotrizinol (BEMT) is the first new ingredient approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for use in over-the-counter SPFs in the states since 1999. Now, brands such as La Roche-Posay, Neutrogena and Ultra Violette have launched new skus in the US formulated with the BEMT

title: L’Oréal hails ‘exceptional’ third quarter 2026 led by dermatological and professional beauty
summary: The CeraVe and Kérastase owner’s business grew across all divisions in the third quarter of 2026, with a ‘remarkable’ performances from professional products and dermatological beauty

title: Dove launches first fragrance inspired by its Original Beauty Bar due to demand
summary: The Unilever-owned beauty brand has broken into the perfume category with a limited edition fine fragrance that smells like its 69-year-old hero sku, Original Beauty Bar, stating its community has ‘been asking for years’ for it to bottle the scent
